svg.aria-label: anon.wei: the ETH pool is the front door on Ethereum, Base and Robinhood Chain; deposit, swap and send into the other private pools and hold everything in one private balance
svg.text: ONE FRONT DOOR · A PRIVATE POOL PER ASSET · ETHEREUM, BASE, ROBINHOOD CHAIN
Swap or send out of the ETH pool and the funds arrive in the other pool with no link back to your wallet. Each pool keeps its own anonymity set; the ETH pool is the deepest.
